provenance.diagnostic: the 4 Mi phases repeated in one process; per-repetition records

estimators.ratio: none: no ratio is published from this file
estimators.columns: Per repetition: the probe's self-counted user-mode cpu_core counters, the CPU before and after the phase, time enabled and running (cumulative over the process), and per repetition the [heap] present pages, pages whose frame reads 0 and pages on the previous repetition's frame. No frame numbers.
